units.source_text: 不多片刻，信子、妹妹、妹夫一同围坐在晚饭桌旁。

en.t: Before long, Nobuko, her younger sister, and her brother-in-law sat together around the dinner table.

units.source_text: 听照子跟大家炫耀，晚餐的鸡蛋都是家里养的鸡下的。

en.t: Teruko boasted to everyone that the eggs served at dinner had all been laid by chickens they kept at home.

units.source_text: 俊吉作为妹夫一边热情的劝信子喝葡萄酒，一边谈一些社会主义核心价值观的论调：

en.t: Shunkichi, as her brother-in-law, warmly urged Nobuko to drink some wine while talking in a socialist-sounding vein:

units.source_text: “人们是靠掠夺维持生活的，从微小的地方来看，比如我们吃的这鸡蛋……”

en.t: People sustain their lives by plunder; if you look at it on the smallest scale, take these eggs we are eating, for instance...

units.source_text: 但是三个人当中，俊吉毋庸置疑是最爱吃鸡蛋的。

en.t: But of the three of them, Shunkichi was undoubtedly the one who loved eggs the most.

units.source_text: 照子觉得这很搞笑，像稚子般笑起来。

en.t: Teruko found this very funny and burst out laughing like a little child.

units.source_text: 有感于饭桌上的气氛，信子情不自禁的想起来自己在遥远的大阪松林中的起居室里度过的寂静黄昏。

en.t: Moved by the atmosphere at the table, Nobuko could not help remembering the quiet dusk she had spent in the sitting room among the distant pines of Osaka.
